language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the app language. Install community translation packs or export a pack to share.
language.removeConfirm: Remove this translation pack from the app?

defaultLocation.title: Default Location
defaultLocation.desc: Folder shown in the Locations tab, and the library scan root flagged as Default Location. Scan now walks it when a path is set; scan on start, interval, and Watch use the controls on this row.

customStylesheet.title: Custom Stylesheet
customStylesheet.desc: You can include your custom css stylesheet to change style of app more than what theme can do.

otherSettings.title: Other Settings
otherSettings.hardwareAccelerationDesc: Use GPU to accelerate rendering. Prevents reader stuttering.
otherSettings.confirmCloseWindowDesc: Ask for confirmation before closing a window.
otherSettings.minimizeToTrayDesc: When enabled, minimize sends the window to the system tray instead of the taskbar. One window: left-click tray toggles show/hide. Multiple windows: left-click restores or focuses. Right-click: window list, Hide all Windows, Exit.
otherSettings.useExistingWindowDesc: Open files in current window and focus it when launching the app again. Disabled: open in new window.
otherSettings.openOnDblClickDesc: Open items from home location list in reader on double click.
otherSettings.syncSettingsDesc: Sync app settings across all opened windows.
otherSettings.syncThemesDesc: Sync themes across all opened windows.
otherSettings.chapterOpeningShortcutDesc: Open chapter directly by clicking name instead of arrow in reader if chapter folder is in manga folder inside default location.
otherSettings.bookmarkHistorySearchDesc: Show search bar over bookmarks and history list.
otherSettings.classicListCheckboxesDesc: Show multi-select checkboxes on home Bookmark / History rows (classic view).
otherSettings.confirmSideListDeleteDesc1: Confirm before deleting item from history/bookmark/note in side list.
otherSettings.autoZenModeDesc: Open reader in "Zen Mode" by default. Applies to opening from file explorer as well.
otherSettings.autoRefreshSideListDesc: Automatically refresh reader-side-list when change in files is detected. It can be heavy task if you have slow storage and chapter+page count is high.
otherSettings.canvasBasedRenderingDesc1: Make scrolling smooth and prevent stuttering when reading high res images.
otherSettings.canvasBasedRenderingDesc2: Drawbacks : high RAM usage and less sharp images when size is set to a low value.
otherSettings.dynamicImageLoadingDesc1: Removes Initial loading screen and load Images as you scroll. Doesn't work with "Canvas Based Rendering"
otherSettings.dynamicImageLoadingDesc2: Drawbacks : Inconsistent scroll size, no double-span images support, stuttering while scrolling.
otherSettings.autoFocusChapterDesc: Automatically focus/scroll to current chapter entry in side-list when changing chapter. Can cause huge performance loss in case of epub with large number (> 500) of chapters.
otherSettings.epubAutoFocusChapter: EPUB: Auto-Focus current chapter in side-list
otherSettings.epubDisableTextSelect: EPUB: Disable Text Select / Enable double-click zen mode
otherSettings.epubDisableTextSelectDesc: Removes ability to select text in epub reader and enabled double-click zen mode.

styleSettings.title: Style Settings
styleSettings.locationListNumberingDesc: Enabled Location List Numbering. This will be applied to all lists.
styleSettings.chapterTransitionDesc: Show the chapter transition screen that show up at start and end of chapter (only in vertical scroll Reading mode).
styleSettings.moreInfoOnHover: More Info on Bookmark / History Hover
styleSettings.moreInfoOnHoverDesc: Show more info such as "date", "total pages", "last page number", "path" when mouse over items in bookmark / history tab.
styleSettings.readerSettingsCheckboxDesc: Show checkbox instead of toggle in reader settings.

dbBackup.title: Library Database Backup
dbBackup.desc: Automatically backs up the library database (bookmarks, history, progress). Choose how many newest backups to keep after each backup. A schema update also snapshots the library even when automatic backups are off.
dbBackup.importIntegrityFailed: The selected file failed the database integrity check.
dbBackup.importCopyFailed: Could not copy the selected file into backups.
dbBackup.backupFailed: Backup failed. Check the logs for details.

reset.title: Reset
reset.libraryMessage: This will delete all entries from library including bookmarks. Continue?
reset.themesMessage: This will delete all Themes. Continue?
reset.themesConfirm:
Are you really sure you want to delete all Themes?
This process is irreversible.
reset.settingsMessage: This will reset all Settings. Continue?
reset.settingsConfirm:
Are you really sure you want to reset settings?
This process is irreversible.

library.title: Library
library.intro: Set the Default Location used by the Locations tab, add extra folders to scan into the library, then manage cover thumbnails.
library.thumbnailsDescBefore: Generated thumbnails live under app user data
library.clearRegenDesc: Clear generated files to free space, or rebuild WebP thumbnails for every library item.
library.scanDescBefore: Walks nested folders under each enabled root. Manga series (chapter folders, one-shot image folders, or packed files) and
library.scanDescAfter: books are added. Grouping folders are not added. Existing paths are skipped. Continue Reading stays empty until you open a title.
library.scanNowDesc: Scan now walks every library folder that exists on disk, including Default Location when a path is set. Nested folders are skipped while walking a parent root.
library.foldersDesc: Extra folders Scan now can walk, in addition to Default Location above. Each folder (and Default Location) has content type, walk depth, scan on start, minutes between scans (0 is off), Watch, a skip pattern, and folder tags. Default Location cannot be removed; change its path instead.
library.scanNoRoots: Set Default Location or add a library folder first.
library.folderAlreadyAdded: That folder is already in the list.
library.folderMissing: That folder was not found on disk.
library.removeFolderMessage: Remove {{path}} from the list? Titles already in the library stay.
library.maxDepthWarn: Each step walks another grouping-folder level under that root. A high value on a home folder or drive root can take a long time and add many titles. The walk still stops at the app safety ceiling.
library.watchDesc: When Watch is on, new series and books under that folder are added after a short delay. It can be heavy on slow disks, network shares, and large trees.
library.watchConfirmMessage: Watch keeps a live filesystem watcher on that folder. New series and books are added automatically after a short delay, without asking.
library.watchConfirmDetail: This can be heavy on slow disks, network shares, and large trees, especially with a high max depth. Copying or extracting files can trigger bursts of work. Turn Watch off if the app or drive becomes sluggish. Existing library titles are not removed.
library.clearUnusedProgressDesc: Remove reading progress that was created when a title was added but never actually read. Catalogue entries stay. Does not run during Scan now.
library.clearUnusedProgressDetail: Only rows that look unread (first page or empty position, no chapters marked, timestamp next to when the library entry was created) are removed.
library.clearUnusedProgressNone: No unused progress rows to remove.
library.clearCacheMessage: Remove all generated thumbnail files in the app data covers folder?
library.clearCacheDetail: Gallery will show placeholders until thumbnails are created again (open items or regenerate).
library.regenMessage: Rebuild WebP thumbnails for every library item? This may take several minutes.
library.regenDetail: Manga uses folder cover images when present; books require reading each EPUB. You can cancel by closing the app.
library.regenError: Regenerate stopped due to an error.
library.regenSkippedMessage_one: Skipped {{count}} library item because its file or folder was not found.
library.regenSkippedMessage_other: Skipped {{count}} library items because their files or folders were not found.
library.setDefaultFirst: Set a valid Default Location first.
library.skipPatternHint: Names that contain a match are skipped (folder and file names, not the full path). Empty turns it off. More Info has examples.
library.skipPatternInvalid: That pattern is not a valid regular expression. Scan will not skip names by pattern until it is fixed.
library.ignoreSentinelHint: A file named yomikiru-ignore or .yomikiru-ignore inside a folder skips that folder. A folder with that name skips only itself. More Info has the difference.
library.folderTagsHint: New titles found under this folder receive these tags. Existing titles keep their tags; use Apply to existing to add them.
library.backfillTooltip: Add these tags to existing titles under this folder.
library.backfillNone: No library titles sit under this folder (outside other library folders).
library.backfillMessage: Add these tags to {{count}} titles already in the library under this folder? Other tags on those titles stay.
library.importMessage: Walk nested folders and add manga series and EPUB books to the library. Grouping folders are skipped. Existing entries are skipped. This does not mark titles as in-progress.
library.importError: Scan stopped due to an error.

theme.title: Theme
theme.sameName:
Same theme name detected. Wont be imported.
Name: {{name}}
theme.badFormat: Data is not in correct format.
theme.invalidThemeData: Invalid theme data. Please note that data must be similar to the result of "Copy Current Theme to Clipboard"

readerPresets.title: Reader Presets
readerPresets.desc: Reset default presets, or export/import/share manga and book reader presets. Custom presets only (default presets excluded from export).
readerPresets.noPresetSelected: No preset selected. Apply a preset first, then copy.
readerPresets.idExists: Preset with this id already exists.
readerPresets.resetDefaultsConfirm: Reset default presets to their original state? Custom presets are kept.

rememberPerItem.label: Remember preset per title
rememberPerItem.desc: Each title can keep its own reader layout. Opening it restores the last preset you used there; changing presets in the reader does not change other titles. Use Select below to set the default for titles that do not have one yet.

fileExplorer.title: File Explorer Option
fileExplorer.desc: Add file explorer option (right click menu) to open item in Yomikiru's reader directly from File Explorer. Use "Use Existing Window" in Other Settings to open in current window.
fileExplorer.addedManga: Explorer option added successfully for manga/image files
fileExplorer.removedManga: Explorer option removed successfully for manga/image files
fileExplorer.addedEpub: Explorer option added successfully for EPUB files
fileExplorer.removedEpub: Explorer option removed successfully for EPUB files

anilist.title: AniList
anilist.desc: Link Yomikiru to your AniList account.
anilist.note: NOTE: Yomikiru does not use internet for anything other than app updates if it is not linked with AniList.
anilist.autoUpdateDesc: Automatically update AniList progress when chapter is read over 70%. Only works if chapter names are well formatted.

pdf.title: PDF OPTIONS
pdf.scaleDesc: Scales PDF render quality. Higher scale results in higher quality.
pdf.renderDescBefore: Render your pdf into png for faster loading. It is recommended to set
pdf.renderDescMid: to something that is not cleaned by your OS.
pdf.renderDescAfter: must be enabled to use this.

tempFolder.title: Custom Temp Folder
tempFolder.desc1: Folder where app will extract archives or epub or render pdf. It can have big effect on extracting speed depending on type of drive (ssd, faster drives) or storage left (10GB+ recommended).
tempFolder.desc2: Defaults to temp folder provided by OS.
tempFolder.keepDesc1: Keep temporary files, mainly extracted archives, pdf and epub. Skip extracting part when opening same title again.
tempFolder.keepDesc2: NOTE: If temp folder is set to default then there is a possibility that your system might delete those files after each power on.

about.betaTitle: Mostly just frequent updates rather than patch.
about.submitIssue: Submit Issue, Feature Request, Ask Question
about.betaWarningMessage: Are you sure you want to switch to beta channel?
about.betaWarningDetail: Beta releases may be unstable and could contain bugs. Use at your own risk.
about.stableOnlyNote: You will only receive update after stable version crosses your current version.

themeMaker.hintLink: To use previously defined color, click on link button and select property from dropdown options.
themeMaker.cantEditDefault: Can't edit default themes, save as new instead.
themeMaker.nameExists: Theme name "{{name}}" already exist, choose something else.

shortcuts.hintRestart: Some changes may require app to restart.
shortcuts.hintMiddleMouse: You can use middle mouse button or grab to scroll reader.
shortcuts.hintMouse45: Mouse button 4 or 5 (back/forward): hover over "Add New" input first, then click to bind.
shortcuts.reloadUiClearCache: Reload UI and try to clear cache
